capabilities: chat with agents that call tools to search, read, create, append and edit notes
configure multiple agents with per-agent providers, keys, models and system prompts
search the web via provider-native search or a bundled Tavily-backed tool
save conversations to a single memory note scheduled for review on a forgetting curve
route AI requests through a local HTTP proxy or a Magpie gateway template
extras: Write actions ask for confirmation by default; the agent has no delete, move or shell tools. The optional local proxy and SQLite history importer are desktop-oriented, and the memory note's <!-- memory:data --> comment must not be hand-edited or review progress is lost.
intentEvidence: The closest equivalent overseas (Claudian) requires the Claude Code CLI and an overseas subscription
motivation: The author built it because the overseas equivalent (Claudian) depends on the Claude Code CLI and foreign payment, while this plugin needs only a pasted API key from a Chinese provider.
problem: Existing agent plugins like Claudian require a Claude Code CLI and an overseas subscription, which mainland China users find hard to set up and pay for.
